description: Free comparison of two supplied 402rates Treasury snapshots: yield, issuer divergence, source identifiers, calculation windows and data availability. Reports numeric threshold crossings without assigning economic significance. No new data access, authentication of snapshots, historical reconstruction or automatic monitoring. Examples are synthetic.

after.description: Later saved response. Input origin is not independently authenticated.

before.description: Earlier saved yields, single instrument or complete instrument response; schema_version 0.5.0.

threshold_bps.description: Absolute change in issuer_vs_basis_bps to flag, default 5; zero flags only nonzero changes.

name: compare_rwa_snapshots
title: Compare yield and divergence fields in two saved Treasury responses
